description: This source file implements the RBusApi class, which provides wrapped access to an underlying RBus API, along with function pointer aliases for these methods. It also includes some mock or testing code elements such as expectations and stub functions, and references to external headers like <gmock/gmock.h> and a custom 'RBus.h'.

classes.name: RBusApi
classes.description: A wrapper class for RBus API functions, managing a static implementation pointer and providing methods to interact with the underlying RBus system.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the current implementation of the RBus API, with expectations for nullptr management.

methods.name: rbus_open
methods.description: Opens an RBus handle for a component.

methods.name: rbusObject_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an RBus object.

methods.name: rbusValue_GetString
methods.description: Gets a string from an RBus value.

methods.name: rbusValue_SetString
methods.description: Sets a string value in an RBus value.

methods.name: rbusValue_Release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an RBus value.
